C0541.title: Ping An Beijing Discloses Woman Detained for Return-Policy Clothing Swap Fraud
keywords: Ping An Beijing return-policy clothing swap fraud case
C0541.summary: In June 2026, CCTV.com republished a Ping An Beijing notice stating that a Beijing woman surnamed Shi exploited e-commerce return rules, including seven-day no-reason returns, refused-delivery returns, and refunds without returns. Using vacant apartment addresses and courier errands, she swapped new clothes for old or dirty clothes before seeking refunds. Police said she ordered more than 100 garments from three stores, kept over 90 swapped items in this incident worth more than 20,000 yuan. From 2022 to 2026, Shi also repeatedly registered new accounts and used the same method to seek refunds for kitchenware, bedding, and other goods; she was criminally detained on suspicion of fraud.

references.title: Online shopping became zero-yuan shopping? The scheme ended in detention
